entities.summary: Daniel Lorenzo Hackett is an American–Italian professional basketball player for Virtus Bologna of the Italian Lega Basket Serie A (LBA) and the EuroLeague. Standing at 1.96 m, he can play at both the point guard and shooting guard positions.
